name: sol8-evidence-search-fit
goal: Keep the entire evidence search placeholder visible at desktop, tablet and mobile without changing its accessible label.

evidence: API baseline 588388c4b5fc9673d2fe8bf2bdb0170f437a3d4d417c1f3d70913fd3a883003a at 6bd7a6150f shows the mobile placeholder clipped, while desktop and tablet fit.

The existing gallery matrix covered filled search and open status filters but did not compare the empty placeholder text width with the input content width. Add that assertion after its canonical capture.
